items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Well, she was a Beatrice, Oynes, she's a McLean now.

ctx.x: When she said Parant, you mean Talbot.

Yeah. That was Talbot, you know, Elmer Talbot. And Richard McLean, well, he's right there in the French quarters right now. We always call him, like I said Parant, because that's what he stands for. And also, that's my niece, Miss McLean, you know, husband. Well, she was a Beatrice, Oynes, she's a McLean now. And that's her son there. He showed you there. Yes, Oynes.
